mode.title: Mode
mode.lead: Choose how this computer works. You can change it again at any time.
mode.online.what: Uses the internet to update content and talk to the lab.
mode.offline.what: No internet. Everything on this computer keeps working.
mode.survival.what: Emergency screen with the basics. Starts at once.
mode.changing: Changing to {mode} … This can take a few minutes. You can keep using the computer.
mode.suggest: There has been no internet for more than 30 minutes. Survival mode keeps the basics ready.
mode.confirm.title: Change to {mode}?
mode.confirm.online: The computer will use the internet again: content updates at night, and the lab can see it.
mode.confirm.offline: The computer stops using the internet. Chat, library, maps and voice keep working.
mode.confirm.survival: The emergency screen opens full screen with the basics: chat, library, maps, first aid. The survival brain is loaded.
mode.leave.title: Leave survival mode?
mode.leave.lead: The emergency screen closes and the normal screen comes back. Nothing is deleted.
mode.busy: Another change is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
mode.portalOnly: To leave survival mode, use the Local AI app on this computer.
